title: Sarasvatichandra
subtitle: Mysteries and Passions Along Sundargiri’s Shores
summary: In the evocative landscapes where rivers meet the sea, Sarasvatichandra unfolds a tale of longing, ideals, and tangled destinies. As ancient forests and vibrant villages conceal secrets and silent desires, a solitary figure’s quest for meaning will upend the lives of many. Enter a world where every tranquil scene hides a deeper intrigue, and every heart yearns for truth.
